title: Top 4 Claude Code Plugins to use while Vibe Coding
description:
Don't start vibe coding with Claude Code unless you have installed these 4 plugins.

First is Ponytail.

It optimizes your Claude Code's output.

It cuts your token usage by over 50% without losing any accuracy at all.

Second is OmniRoute.

It gives your Claude Code almost unlimited usage by connecting to over 300 free AI providers.

The moment your usage limit runs out, it automatically switches you to the next best model.

Giving you up to 1.6 billion free tokens every single month.

Third is Graphify.

It turns your entire codebase into a knowledge graph.

So your agent doesn't waste tokens by re-reading files again and again.

And finally, Agent Skills.

It's a pack of 24 skills that let you vibe code like a senior engineer.

Built by the former AI engineering director at Google.

It has dedicated skills for planning, coding, testing, and publishing.

It activates the right one at different stages of coding, all on its own.

#claudecode #vibecoding #aicoding #omniroute #agentskills
